In Hindu mythology, Jigisha is the name of the goddess of desire, who is believed to grant the deepest desires of the heart. The name is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity, who is often depicted as the embodiment of desire. Jigisha is a powerful and evocative name, filled with the promise of fulfillment and abundance.
